1.consolidated_definition: Llamado también tren jamaiquino es ‘el conjunto de calderas o pailas por que ha de pasar el guarapo para clarificarse, descachazarse y adquirir el punto de meladura, se llama tren’. José García Arboleya, Manual de la isla de Cuba, 2da ed., 1859.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Called also Jamaican train is 'the set of boilers or cauldrons through which the guarapo must pass to clarify itself, degas and acquire the honey-like consistency point, it is called tren'. José García Arboleya, Manual of the island of Cuba, 2nd ed., 1859.
